'''Basher''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] criminal and a member of the notorious gang known as the [[Fondor Five]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the gang was spotted operating on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Because of the gang's violent tendencies, the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] placed a high bounty on their heads. The bounty was eventually collected after all five gang members were killed in a firefight in the [[Fartrader Lounge]].<ref name="TOR" />
